  idle, spin [--rate degrees-per-tick], daycycle [--step world-ticks]
  walk [--radius blocks], travel [--speed blocks-per-tick --distance blocks]
  farlands [--axis x|z --sign +|- --shift blocks --speed blocks-per-tick --distance blocks]
  building [--size blocks --floors N --torch_spacing blocks]
  lighting [--count N --period ticks --width blocks --depth blocks]
  fluids [--size blocks --spacing blocks], tnt [--count N --period ticks]
  mobs [--count N], entities [--count N], cave [--width blocks --depth blocks]
  crops (all eight growth stages, four rows, ordinary world rendering)
  clouds (interpolated cloud-boundary crossings and changing daylight)
Renderer-parity scenes (fixed world, time, weather and camera; one scene each):
  parity_terrain_above, parity_terrain_below (terrain and cube faces above/below)
  parity_transparent (leaves, glass, ice, water, lava, fire)
  parity_texturefx (water/lava still and flowing, fire, portal, compass, clock)
  parity_clouds_below, parity_clouds_above
  parity_sky_day, parity_sky_night, parity_sky_dawn (sun, moon, stars, sunrise fan;
                      need --view-distance 0 or 1, the sky pass does not run above)
  parity_particles (every particle kind, block-break and dispenser events)
  parity_gui_hud, parity_gui_inventory (HUD, chat font, screen, 3D slot items)
  parity_sign (standing and wall signs, font in world space)
  parity_held_item [--item block|tool|flat|hand]
  parity_break_outline [--target progress 0.05-0.95] (crack overlay plus outline)
  parity_rain, parity_snow [--thunder 0|1 --search blocks] (biome-matched site)
  parity_fog_underwater, parity_fog_lava (submerged exponential fog and overlay)
  parity_fog_distance (linear fog with distance pillars; reports eye-radial mode)
  parity_fog_nether (run built on the Hell dimension provider)
Mobs, dropped items and other entities are covered by the mobs and entities
scenarios; --fancy and --anaglyph select fast/fancy, ambient occlusion and anaglyph
for every scene. Parity scenes drain the chunk queue before measuring.
all runs each offline renderer scenario once with normal lighting and a fresh level.
Only --seed is accepted as a scenario parameter for all. Options may be mixed.
--backend or B173_RENDERER selects the renderer before
device creation. Native backends must be enabled in the build. No null sink,
fullbright, server, authentication, saved-world loading or audio-only scenarios.
Existing output directories are rejected. Exit: 0 complete, 1 runtime failure, 2 usage error.
